activities.title: Welcome Back: Build Your Final Board
activities.summary: Students study one finished model board and answer short visible-clue questions about the required sections and their purpose.

en.title: Welcome Back: Build Your Final Board
en.summary: Look at the model board and choose the best answer for each quick question.

success_criteria: I can identify the main sections of the mini design board.

Eu consigo usar pistas visiveis da prancha para responder a cada pergunta.

input.prompt_en: Choose the best answer for each question about the mini design board.

items.label_en: Which section tells the main idea of the design source?

expected_output.description_en: Five app-checked selections about the sections and purpose of the model mini design board.

completion_criteria_en: The student answers all five questions.
